text:
Power 
 Station | Technical 
 Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection list I1, which must be carried 
 out on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the above title block.
This pump is used to reheat the water that transferred by condensate pump to 
 dearator.
The first draft initiated & tested by eng. Reda Abou El-Nasr, accepted by eng. Magdy 
 Okba, and approved by eng. Ahmed Sowan: head sector of Nubaria Power Station.
This document reviewed by Quality control eng. Magdy Hegazym, accepted by eng. Samir Abdel Gilil; MEPC inspection & quality 
 control general director & MPIS coordinator, and certified by eng Mohamed 
 Nageeb Abd El-Haie: MDEPC inspection & quality control's head sector.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued.
Safety 
 fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
The maintenance staff should be trained, qualified, and carry the suitable ID safety category.
Safety 
 fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety 
 shoes, breathing mask ... etc.
Isolate the circuit breaker of the pump motor
Disconnect electric terminals of the pump motor
Isolate the pump mechanically by closing delivery and suction 
 valves.
Be sure pump must be completely drainage.
Tools and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool set.
Cleaning fluid.Manual puller.
Feeler gauge, Dial indicator
Vibrometer, Straight edge and rags.
Work to be Carried Out
Pump in Operation
Measure vibration level for bearings and compare it with the setting value, 
 then analyze it and determine what to do?, also check for noisy.
Check the pump capacity, pressure and power. if pump performance does satisfy 
 your process requirements, and process requirements have not changed, pump 
 should be disassembled, inspection, and worn parts should be replaced.
Otherwise, a system inspection should be done.
Check the Temperature of bearing.
Pump out of Operation
Check alignment and compare it with the setting value.
Check the glands leakage.
Check the pump and piping for leaks.
Check the fixation.
Starting the Pump
Before Starting the Pump
Check the oil level.
Check the cooling water.
Check the direction of rotation of motor before starting.
Check the suction and delivery.
Attendance and
Checking during 
Operation of the Pump
Check the oil temperature and oil leakage.
Check the water temperature and water leakage.
Check the vibration level.
Check pump capacity.
Check pump pressure and power.
Check pump temperature of bearing.
If pump performance does satisfy your process requirements, and process 
 requirements have not changed, pump should be disassembled, inspection, and 
 worn parts should be replaced. Otherwise, a system inspection should be done.
